# cf-webmcp

A Cloudflare Worker that equips any website with WebMCP from a single TOML config.

## Pages
- [Home](http://localhost:8788/)
- [About](http://localhost:8788/about)
- [Install](http://localhost:8788/install)
- [Docs](http://localhost:8788/docs)
- [Forms](http://localhost:8788/forms): declarative WebMCP form attribute demo with three forms (contact, subscribe_newsletter, search_site)
